## Featured Software & Security Projects
1. **PenTest Hub**: Lightweight, modular web vulnerability scanner for penetration testers and cybersecurity students. Automates OWASP Top 10 auditing and generates HTML/PDF compliance reports.
2. **iOS Security Scanner**: Open-source Swift-based static & dynamic CLI analysis tool scanning iOS `.app` and `.ipa` bundles for insecure keychain access, misconfigured ATS (App Transport Security), and binary hardening flaws.
3. **Secure Vault**: iOS Password Manager built with SwiftUI, Apple CryptoKit (AES-256 GCM), Core Data, and hardware Secure Enclave biometric entitlements.
